source.author: 张家佳
source.observed_action: Diagnose sparse/dense imbalance in two-character wordmark, change composition topology and reauthor coordinated curves rather than merely stack fonts
source.not_used: No tracing, source geometry or direct copying of 上座

observed_prior_failure.R25: 山月 had original editable vector strokes but no strong group-level design language; nine paths did not establish aesthetics
observed_prior_failure.R24: Prompt-generated PNG mimicked typeface, no Figma construction

experiment.linguistic_layout: 云 (sparse) + 间 (enclosing densely), both simplified Chinese and legible
experiment.meaning: clouds between spaces; original research sample not existing commercial wordmark
experiment.intent: Restrained cloud-eaves gesture as a shared structural stroke, not scenery, ink particles or decorative flourish
experiment.A: Independently hand-authored recognizable 云 and 间 with separate first horizontal and 门 upper roof/right hook, equal-cell composition.
experiment.B: Keep most contours identical; remove 云 top horizontal and 门 upper roof/right hook; author a single non-uniform long shared roof that replaces both independently, connecting through the gap and into 间 right hook. Retune if needed only after visible QA, never tune for metric alone.
experiment.not_a_font: All cubic outlines manually written SVG path data, imported as native individually selectable Figma vector nodes, no TEXT, no existing font outlines or PNG tracing.
experiment.not_a_designer_clone: Source mechanism inferred at conceptual level, not genuine author contours, weights or process history.

success_conditions: Two distinct readable simplified glyph identities remain at 150px AND 75px wordmark-size
A and B truly differ in number/topology of independent vector paths, not horizontal x-scaling or decoration
Single signed continuous shared roof follows recognizable structural strokes in both characters
B has a visually stronger compositional identity and does not visually read as one malformed character
Actual Figma native VECTOR path readback, authentic source export and screenshots
No claims of professional style improvement before independent human blind preference
reject_conditions: Inter-glyph bridge visually becomes arbitrary decorative stripe
间 loses recognizable 门 roof or internal 日
云 loses normal two-horizontal+厶 structure
B white counter space becomes closed
Additional revisions only numeric tuning without changed visual intent
